## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that combining the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup with a VWAP confirmation filter can improve the edge capture. The VWAP confirmation filter checks if the first 3 RTH closes are all on the same side of the session VWAP, indicating a directional bias.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves adding a VWAP confirmation filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup. The filter checks if the first 3 RTH closes are all on the same side of the session VWAP. If the filter is true, the setup fires an entry signal.
